run_pddm_cli: run the pddm command line tool to process PDDM directives in source files
run_pddm_dry_run: run pddm with --dry-run to check if files need updating without writing changes
run_pddm_collapse: run pddm with --collapse to remove all generated code from source files
expand_macro_collection: expand macro references using MacroCollection.Expand to resolve PDDM macro invocations
parse_macro_definitions: parse PDDM macro definitions from source lines using MacroCollection.ParseLines
